summary: This is a routine earnings release on Form 6-K filed by Gildan Activewear Inc., a foreign private issuer, reporting first quarter 2026 results. The filing details record revenue of $1.17 billion, up 63.8% year-over-year, primarily driven by the prior HanesBrands acquisition. It discusses integration progress, synergy targets of ~$100 million in 2026 and ~$250 million annual run-rate, and maintains full-year guidance. There are no new special-situation transactions such as a tender offer, activist campaign, or restructuring announced. The filing is a standard periodic financial update with no event-based corporate action.
